title: Interest Start Date on Income Annuities Arrears Installments by State of Issue
content:
The interest on an arrears installment paid to the beneficiary of an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract runs for the actual days from a start date to the payment date. The start date is fixed by the state of issue and by when the death first came to Ashgrove's notice:

- **Connecticut, Minnesota, New Jersey or New York.** The interest runs for the actual days from the date of death to the payment date.
- **Any other state, death reported before due proof.** For a contract issued in any other state whose annuitant's death was reported to Ashgrove before due proof of death was received, it runs from the date the death was first reported to the payment date. The report is the death report on file for the contract; due proof is the death claim whose certified death certificate is shown as received; "before" means the report's received date is earlier than the received date of due proof.
- On any other contract neither of these start dates applies.

### Input, judgement, result (hypothetical dates)

| State of issue | Date of death | Death report received | Due proof received | Payment date | Days of interest |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| New York | 10 March | 12 March | 2 April | 1 May | 52 (10 March to 1 May) |
| Texas | 10 March | 12 March | 2 April | 1 May | 50 (12 March to 1 May) |
| Texas | 10 March | 2 April (same day as proof) | 2 April | 1 May | Neither start date applies |
| Texas | 10 March | none on file | 2 April | 1 May | Neither start date applies |
